source.prompt: (the red-tail's) A red-tailed hawk (Buteo jamaicensis), one adult bird soaring in mid-air, wings fully spread out flat to the sides and symmetrical, about 125 cm wingspan and 55 cm long, shaped to read from below and from above. Broad rounded wings with a straight leading edge and five separated, fingered primary feathers at each wingtip. Short, broad brick-red tail fanned wide into a rounded fan. Legs and feet tucked up under the body. Big rounded head and short hooked bill projecting ahead of the wings. Pale underwing with a dark leading-edge bar and a dark wrist mark, pale breast with a dark belly band. Not an eagle, not a falcon. Single bird, no base, no perch. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: Ambient flight mesh as the hawk's and the eagle's: body and head from the generated mesh (feet and tail deleted, head reshaped, pitched 12 degrees nose-down); short rounded wings with the wrists pushed forward and five short slotted primaries, a long narrow square-tipped tail (0.15 m from its root, 0.13 m behind the wing, about the wing's 0.11 m chord), a small head that barely projects; the wings, tail lofted per tier in rows and stations placed on the field marks (lod2 wings 2.5x thicker). Tier switches suggested at 40 and 140 m (not wired). GLB 344,244 bytes.

rig: bird rig template, flight mesh, exactly as client/assets/redtail.glb (the client draws the raptors with the hawk's soaring and the gulls with the vulture's circling glides): PART BODY 0, TAIL 3 (pivot at the tail root), HEAD 6 (head, neck, pivot at the neck's base), WING_L/R 4/5 (the arm, pivot at the shoulder, weight ramped in over the wing root), HAND_L/R 9/10 (pivot at the wrist, weight ramped over the hand; the primaries fully HAND); collapse 0 (the wings never fold). extras.rig keys as the hawk's: kind 'bird', wing (shoulder [0.034, 0.11, 0.02]), wrist [0.122, 0.116, 0.02], tail [0.0, 0.097, -0.022], head [0.0, 0.107, 0.073], span_m 0.58, dihedral_deg 1.4 (shoulder to wingtip). Origin 0.11 m below the shoulder line. No skin.
accuracy_notes: Field marks: slate blue-grey above, the tail grey with four broad dark bands and a pale tip; below barred rusty-orange on white with white undertail coverts, the underwing white barred grey (coverts faintly buff); a dark cap, rufous cheeks, a red-orange eye (lod0), yellow cere and dark bill. Reads as a small accipiter: short round wings, long banded tail, small head, rusty underparts and barred underwing from below, slate above. Still open: the underparts' fine barring is drawn as alternating bands on decimated faces, so it reads as jagged rusty triangles rather than fine bars; the far tiers lose the tail bands (lod1 keeps them; lod2 plain grey); the head is the red-tail's shrunk 0.84x, a little large-billed; one size for both sexes; the line between a sharp-shinned and a Cooper's hawk (head projection, tail tip shape) is fine and only roughly honoured.
